summary.name: Inventaire
summary.one_liner: Inventaire is a web app for cataloguing your books, sharing them with friends or communities, and tracking books you lend or borrow.
keywords: keep track of books lent out
use_cases: track books you lend to friends
run a shared library for a book club
share a library with a coworking space or association
mark books as giveable, lendable or for sale
summary.what_it_does: Inventaire lets users keep an inventory of their books and note what can be done with each one, such as giving, lending, or selling it. Users can share their inventory with friends and communities, which the page presents as a way to build a collaborative library for a coworking space, association, or book club. It includes a way to remember books lent or borrowed. The project's listing describes it as focused on mapping books using Wikidata and ISBNs, and it is open source under AGPL-3.0 and built with Node.js.
notable: Collaborative sharing of book inventories with friends and communities
Maps books using Wikidata and ISBNs
Tracks books lent out and borrowed
caveats: The listing describes the project as still focused mainly on exploring book mapping with Wikidata and ISBNs
The page itself does not state hosting or pricing details
